terms: Payment Terms & Advance
Advance Remittance: Full payment must be transferred in advance to the designated seller bank account.
Payment Reference: The Proforma Invoice (PI) number must be clearly quoted in the transfer instructions.
Transfer Confirmation: Proof of transfer (TT / SWIFT copy) must be submitted immediately upon payment.
Bank Charges & Fees
Buyer Liability: All remittance, intermediary, receiving, and currency conversion fees are borne by the buyer/consignee.
Fixed Banking Surcharge: A standard fee of USD 25 must be remitted over the invoice total to cover receiving bank charges in Japan.
Allocation & Stock Availability
Payment Prioritization: Vehicle booking is finalized solely upon receipt of cleared full payment.
Prior Sale: Units are subject to prior sale. If a unit is sold before full funds clear, an equivalent vehicle cannot be guaranteed at the same quoted price.
Shipping & Transfer of Risk
Carrier Terms: Shipping is arranged subject to the carrier’s terms once full payment has cleared.
Passing of Risk: Risk of loss, damage, or theft transfers to the buyer upon delivery to the carrier / terminal facility.
Transit & Delays: The seller is not liable for carrier schedule changes, port delays, theft, or transit damage.
Export Documentation
Document Release: Original shipping and export documents (B/L, Export Certificate) are issued and dispatched only after 100% invoice settlement.
Third-Party Liability: The seller is not liable for losses or demurrage from delayed, retained, or lost documents handled by couriers or authorities.
Customs, Taxes & Compliance
Duties & Taxes: Customs clearance, tariffs, and local port taxes are the exclusive responsibility of the buyer.

Import Compliance: The buyer must ensure compliance with destination country laws (age limits, drive side, standards). The buyer indemnifies the seller against any denied entry or regulatory penalties.
Cancellation & Default
Non-Cancellable: Orders become strictly non-cancellable once shipping has been booked.
Default & Resale: Failure to pay the full invoice before vessel arrival constitutes default. The seller reserves the right to resell the unit and reallocate funds to cover expenses.
"AS-IS, WHERE-IS" Disclaimer
No Warranties: Vehicles are sold strictly "AS-IS, WHERE-IS" without express or implied warranty of condition, roadworthiness, fitness for purpose, or mechanical state.
Mileage & Maintenance: No warranty is made regarding odometer accuracy. Vehicles may require servicing or repairs at the buyer’s cost.
accept: Remitting payment, confirming this proforma, or acting on this invoice constitutes full, irrevocable acceptance of all terms, conditions, and disclaimers specified above.
